amulet_mould.description: A fired clay mould for amulet-making.
amulet_mould.acquisition: Made through Crafting at level 1 at a fire using Imprinted Amulet Mould x1.
amulet_mould.uses: Used for matching amulet jewelry recipes after the amulet mould unlock. Complete Moulds of the Trade for Elira Gemhand to earn all three unlocks.

bear_leather.description: A leather crafting material used in equipment and strap recipes.
bear_leather.acquisition: Buy it from Tanner Rusk in Starter Town.
bear_leather.uses: It is used in Crafting recipes that produce Yew Handle w/ Strap.

borrowed_amulet.description: Jewelry loaned for clay mould practice.
borrowed_amulet.acquisition: Elira Gemhand supplies it when Moulds of the Trade starts.
borrowed_amulet.uses: Used in Crafting recipes that produce Imprinted Amulet Mould.

borrowed_ring.description: Jewelry loaned for clay mould practice.
borrowed_ring.acquisition: Elira Gemhand supplies it when Moulds of the Trade starts. The Crafting Instructor also supplies a borrowed ring on Tutorial Island.
borrowed_ring.uses: Used in Crafting recipes that produce Imprinted Ring Mould.

bow_string.description: A Fletching supply used to finish wooden bows.
bow_string.uses: It is used in Fletching recipes that produce Maple Longbow, Maple Shortbow, Normal Longbow, Normal Shortbow, Oak Longbow, Oak Shortbow, Willow Longbow, Willow Shortbow, Yew Longbow, and Yew Shortbow.

chisel.description: A basic Crafting tool used to cut gems for higher-tier jewelry.
chisel.acquisition: Buy it from Crafting Teacher in Starter Town.
chisel.uses: It is required to cut sapphire, ruby, emerald, and diamond into their cut forms,.

clay.description: A basic mining resource gathered from Clay Rock nodes.
clay.acquisition: Usually mined from Clay Rock at level 1 in Main Overworld.
clay.uses: Used in Crafting recipes that produce Soft Clay.

cut_diamond.description: A cut diamond used in high-value jewelry and staff recipes.
cut_diamond.acquisition: Made through Crafting at level 40 in the inventory with a Chisel and Uncut diamond x1.
cut_diamond.uses: It is used in Crafting recipes that produce Air Staff, Diamond Gold Amulet, Diamond Gold Ring, and Diamond Gold Tiara, and it can be traded to Elira Gemhand in Starter Town.

cut_emerald.description: A cut emerald used in higher-value jewelry and staff recipes.
cut_emerald.acquisition: Made through Crafting at level 30 in the inventory with a Chisel and Uncut emerald x1.
cut_emerald.uses: It is used in Crafting recipes that produce Earth Staff, Emerald Gold Amulet, Emerald Gold Ring, and Emerald Gold Tiara, and it can be traded to Elira Gemhand in Starter Town.

cut_ruby.description: A cut ruby used in higher-value jewelry and staff recipes.
cut_ruby.acquisition: Made through Crafting at level 10 in the inventory with a Chisel and Uncut ruby x1.
cut_ruby.uses: It is used in Crafting recipes that produce Fire Staff, Ruby Gold Amulet, Ruby Gold Ring, Ruby Gold Tiara, Ruby Silver Amulet, Ruby Silver Ring, and Ruby Silver Tiara, and it can be traded to Elira Gemhand in Starter Town.

cut_sapphire.description: A cut sapphire used in higher-value jewelry and staff recipes.
cut_sapphire.acquisition: Made through Crafting at level 20 in the inventory with a Chisel and Uncut sapphire x1.
cut_sapphire.uses: It is used in Crafting recipes that produce Sapphire Gold Amulet, Sapphire Gold Ring, Sapphire Gold Tiara, Sapphire Silver Amulet, Sapphire Silver Ring, Sapphire Silver Tiara, and Water Staff, and it can be traded to Elira Gemhand in Starter Town.

diamond_gold_amulet.description: A gold amulet set with a cut diamond.
diamond_gold_amulet.acquisition: Made through Crafting at level 40 in the inventory using Gold Amulet x1 and Cut diamond x1.
diamond_gold_amulet.uses: Sell it to Elira Gemhand in Starter Town.

diamond_gold_ring.description: A gold ring set with a cut diamond.
diamond_gold_ring.acquisition: Made through Crafting at level 40 in the inventory using Gold Ring x1 and Cut diamond x1.
diamond_gold_ring.uses: Sell it to Elira Gemhand in Starter Town.

emerald_gold_amulet.description: A gold amulet set with a cut emerald.
emerald_gold_amulet.acquisition: Made through Crafting at level 40 in the inventory using Gold Amulet x1 and Cut emerald x1.
emerald_gold_amulet.uses: Sell it to Elira Gemhand in Starter Town.

emerald_gold_ring.description: A gold ring set with a cut emerald.
emerald_gold_ring.acquisition: Made through Crafting at level 40 in the inventory using Gold Ring x1 and Cut emerald x1.
emerald_gold_ring.uses: Sell it to Elira Gemhand in Starter Town.

gold_amulet.description: A plain gold amulet used as a base for gem-set jewelry.
gold_amulet.acquisition: Made through Smithing at level 44 in a Furnace using Gold Bar x1.
gold_amulet.uses: It is used in Crafting recipes that produce Diamond Gold Amulet, Emerald Gold Amulet, Ruby Gold Amulet, and Sapphire Gold Amulet.

gold_ring.description: A plain gold ring used as a base for gem-set jewelry.
gold_ring.acquisition: Made through Smithing at level 40 in a Furnace using Gold Bar x1.
gold_ring.uses: It is used in Crafting recipes that produce Diamond Gold Ring, Emerald Gold Ring, Ruby Gold Ring, and Sapphire Gold Ring.

imprinted_amulet_mould.description: An unfired clay imprint of a amulet.
imprinted_amulet_mould.acquisition: Near a crafting bench, use Soft Clay on the matching Borrowed Amulet at Crafting level 1. The borrowed jewelry is retained.
imprinted_amulet_mould.uses: Use it on a fire to make a Amulet mould at Crafting level 1.

imprinted_ring_mould.description: An unfired clay imprint of a ring.
imprinted_ring_mould.acquisition: Near a crafting bench, use Soft Clay on the matching Borrowed Ring at Crafting level 1. The borrowed jewelry is retained.
imprinted_ring_mould.uses: Use it on a fire to make a Ring mould at Crafting level 1.

imprinted_tiara_mould.description: An unfired clay imprint of a tiara.
imprinted_tiara_mould.acquisition: Near a crafting bench, use Soft Clay on the matching Borrowed Tiara at Crafting level 1. The borrowed jewelry is retained.
imprinted_tiara_mould.uses: Use it on a fire to make a Tiara mould at Crafting level 1.

needle.description: A basic Crafting tool kept in the Starter Town economy.
needle.acquisition: Buy it from Crafting Teacher in Starter Town.
needle.uses: The Crafting Teacher buys it in Starter Town. No current Crafting recipe requires a Needle.

normal_leather.description: A leather crafting material used in equipment and strap recipes.
normal_leather.acquisition: Buy it from Tanner Rusk in Starter Town.
normal_leather.uses: It is used in Crafting recipes that produce Oak Handle w/ Strap and Wooden Handle w/ Strap.

ring_mould.description: A fired clay mould for ring-making.
ring_mould.acquisition: Made through Crafting at level 1 at a fire using Imprinted Ring Mould x1.
ring_mould.uses: Used for matching ring jewelry recipes after the ring mould unlock. Complete Moulds of the Trade for Elira Gemhand to earn all three unlocks.

ruby_gold_amulet.description: A gold amulet set with a cut ruby.
ruby_gold_amulet.acquisition: Made through Crafting at level 40 in the inventory using Gold Amulet x1 and Cut ruby x1.
ruby_gold_amulet.uses: Sell it to Elira Gemhand in Starter Town.

ruby_gold_ring.description: A gold ring set with a cut ruby.
ruby_gold_ring.acquisition: Made through Crafting at level 40 in the inventory using Gold Ring x1 and Cut ruby x1.
ruby_gold_ring.uses: Sell it to Elira Gemhand in Starter Town.

ruby_silver_amulet.description: A silver amulet set with a cut ruby.
ruby_silver_amulet.acquisition: Made through Crafting at level 10 in the inventory using Silver Amulet x1 and Cut ruby x1.
ruby_silver_amulet.uses: Sell it to Elira Gemhand in Starter Town.

ruby_silver_ring.description: A silver ring set with a cut ruby.
ruby_silver_ring.acquisition: Made through Crafting at level 10 in the inventory using Silver Ring x1 and Cut ruby x1.
ruby_silver_ring.uses: Sell it to Elira Gemhand in Starter Town.

sapphire_gold_amulet.description: A gold amulet set with a cut sapphire.
sapphire_gold_amulet.acquisition: Made through Crafting at level 40 in the inventory using Gold Amulet x1 and Cut sapphire x1.
sapphire_gold_amulet.uses: Sell it to Elira Gemhand in Starter Town.

sapphire_gold_ring.description: A gold ring set with a cut sapphire.
sapphire_gold_ring.acquisition: Made through Crafting at level 40 in the inventory using Gold Ring x1 and Cut sapphire x1.
sapphire_gold_ring.uses: Sell it to Elira Gemhand in Starter Town.

sapphire_silver_amulet.description: A silver amulet set with a cut sapphire.
sapphire_silver_amulet.acquisition: Made through Crafting at level 20 in the inventory using Silver Amulet x1 and Cut sapphire x1.
sapphire_silver_amulet.uses: Sell it to Elira Gemhand in Starter Town.

sapphire_silver_ring.description: A silver ring set with a cut sapphire.
sapphire_silver_ring.acquisition: Made through Crafting at level 20 in the inventory using Silver Ring x1 and Cut sapphire x1.
sapphire_silver_ring.uses: Sell it to Elira Gemhand in Starter Town.

silver_amulet.description: A plain silver amulet used as a base for gem-set jewelry.
silver_amulet.acquisition: Made through Smithing at level 34 in a Furnace using Silver Bar x1.
silver_amulet.uses: It is used in Crafting recipes that produce Ruby Silver Amulet and Sapphire Silver Amulet.

silver_ring.description: A plain silver ring used as a base for gem-set jewelry.
silver_ring.acquisition: Made through Smithing at level 30 in a Furnace using Silver Bar x1.
silver_ring.uses: It is used in Crafting recipes that produce Ruby Silver Ring and Sapphire Silver Ring.

thread.description: A basic Crafting supply kept in the Starter Town economy.
thread.acquisition: Buy it from Crafting Teacher in Starter Town.
thread.uses: The Crafting Teacher buys it in Starter Town. No current Crafting recipe requires Thread.

tiara_mould.description: A fired clay mould for tiara-making.
tiara_mould.acquisition: Made through Crafting at level 1 at a fire using Imprinted Tiara Mould x1.
tiara_mould.uses: Used for matching tiara jewelry recipes after the tiara mould unlock. Complete Moulds of the Trade for Elira Gemhand to earn all three unlocks.

uncut_diamond.description: An uncut diamond that can be refined through Crafting.
uncut_diamond.acquisition: Buy it from Elira Gemhand in Starter Town.
uncut_diamond.uses: It is used in Crafting recipes that produce Cut diamond, and it can be traded back to Elira Gemhand in Starter Town.

uncut_emerald.description: An uncut emerald that can be refined through Crafting.
uncut_emerald.acquisition: Usually mined from Emerald Rock at level 40 in Starter Town, and it is also sold by Elira Gemhand in Starter Town.
uncut_emerald.uses: It is used in Crafting recipes that produce Cut emerald, and it can be traded back to Elira Gemhand in Starter Town.

uncut_ruby.description: An uncut ruby that can be refined through Crafting.
uncut_ruby.acquisition: Buy it from Elira Gemhand in Starter Town.
uncut_ruby.uses: It is used in Crafting recipes that produce Cut ruby, and it can be traded back to Elira Gemhand in Starter Town.

uncut_sapphire.description: An uncut sapphire that can be refined through Crafting.
uncut_sapphire.acquisition: Usually mined from Sapphire Rock at level 30 in Starter Town, and it is also sold by Elira Gemhand in Starter Town.
uncut_sapphire.uses: It is used in Crafting recipes that produce Cut sapphire, and it can be traded back to Elira Gemhand in Starter Town.

wolf_leather.description: A leather crafting material used in equipment and strap recipes.
wolf_leather.acquisition: Buy it from Tanner Rusk in Starter Town.
wolf_leather.uses: It is used in Crafting recipes that produce Maple Handle w/ Strap and Willow Handle w/ Strap.
